text:
Mike Lee: Heads up — we need a solid plan for KMS key rotation across AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault for envelope encryption. Thinking auto rotation where possible + a manual rewrap path for legacy objects. Who can help scope impact?
Sara Gomez: I can help. key questions: do we store key version metadata in object headers today? that determines lazy rewrap feasibility.
Priya Patel: We currently embed a small KEK id + DEK schema version in ciphertext header (field: kek_id and dek_version). So lazy rewrap on read is possible but we must track which objects reference retired KEKs.
Tom Novak: Important: AWS CMK auto-rotation rotates the CMK's underlying material only for AWS-managed keys; for customer-managed CMKs we can enable automatic annual rotation. GCP key versions are explicit; Azure has versions too. We'll need per-cloud behavior docs.
Mike Lee: Agreed. For compatibility model proposal: 1) implement automatic CMK rotation where cloud supports it (enable AWS CMK rotation; create new GCP key versions on schedule; rotate Azure key versions). 2) For DEKs (data keys), keep DEK version in header. On read: if DEK encrypted with old KEK, either lazy rewrap (decrypt with old KEK via KMS then re-encrypt DEK with new KEK) OR queue bulk rewrap job.
Sara Gomez: Ops considerations: KMS API quotas. Rewrap bulk jobs will hit GenerateDataKey / Encrypt/Decrypt QPS. Need throttled workers + backoff + instrumentation. Also ensure CloudTrail / Audit Logs capture rewrap operations for compliance.
Priya Patel: For manual rewrap CLI example (AWS):
```
# decrypt DEK then re-encrypt with new key (pseudo)
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://dek.enc --key-id arn:aws:kms:...:old-key --output text --query Plaintext | base64 --decode > dek.plain
aws kms encrypt --key-id arn:aws:kms:...:new-key --plaintext fileb://dek.plain --output text --query CiphertextBlob > dek_new.enc
```
We should avoid writing plaintext to disk; use in-memory pipes in real jobs.
Tom Novak: Also consider envelope rewrap without exposing plaintext: use KMS re-encrypt API where available (GCP has 'asymmetric/versions'?) AWS has ReEncrypt API which avoids plaintext on client. Prefer that.
Mike Lee: Good call — prefer server-side ReEncrypt/Proxy when available. Action items: - Priya to draft per-cloud rotation doc (APIs, limitations, audit surfaces) - Tom to draft rewrap worker architecture (throttling, canary, metrics) - Sara to write RBAC constraints and audit logging requirements + incident playbook for failed rotations.
Priya Patel: I'll include approach for dual-write during rollout: new writes use new KEK id, reads trigger lazy rewrap only after successful write. For backward compatibility, keep support for decrypting old KEK ids for at least 90 days post-rotation.
Sara Gomez: RBAC: create rotation-principal with only encrypt/decrypt/rewrap rights, grant scoped to key ARNs and emergency-grant path. No long-lived human creds. Audit logs must contain principal, key id, operation, request ID.
Tom Novak: Rollout timing: stagger per-region, small canary (0.5% objects) -> monitor error-rate and latency -> expand 10x per hour with quotas. Plan maintenance windows for heavy bulk rewraps.
Mike Lee: Incident playbook notes: if rewrap job fails or KMS becomes unavailable: fallback to read-only with clear error messages, increase cache TTLs, route to secondary key (if cross-account replicate key exists) or roll back new key usage. Notify security + infra on pager.
Priya Patel: Monitoring: metrics for rewrap success/fail, re-encrypt latency, KMS error codes, KMS throttling (ThrottlingException), audit log ingestion pipeline. Set alerts on elevated Decrypt failures or 5xx from KMS.
Sara Gomez: Compliance: exportable proof-of-rotation: capture timeline of key version creation, principal that initiated, CI artifacts for automated rotation job, and CloudTrail/Audit Logs with re-encrypt ops. Keep those in WORM storage for 1 year.
Tom Novak: Edge case: objects encrypted with customer-supplied keys (Bring-Your-Own-Key) across Dedicated/Private tenants — need consent and coordinated rotation windows. Add tenant opt-out flag and migration plan.
Mike Lee: Timeline proposal: doc + approval by EOW, prototype worker + canary in 2 weeks, full staging run in month, production rollout over next 6-8 weeks after staging success.
Priya Patel: I'll start the per-cloud doc and include ReEncrypt/Grant patterns. tagging @Sara Gomez for RBAC notes.
Sara Gomez: thanks — I'll draft RBAC + incident playbook and share for review. :thumbsup:
key-rotation-bot: scheduled reminder set for 1750004834 (rotation doc review)
Mike Lee: Perfect. If anyone sees regulatory blockers (e.g., keys must never leave HSM) call it out early. Good discussion.
